author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (09/21/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works. Contact: comment on the post or DM @blekek.k on Threads.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Character art: more realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but art should feel grounded and lifelike; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Needs portraits for now, and more if the style fits the series. Map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites on Threads.

author: Allie Higdem
title: Author needs budget character art, no AI
content: I need character art! I'm a little late to the game and would love any recommendations for budget friendly artists that do not use A.I and have availability now/within the next couple months. #authorthreads #bookthreads. Contact: comment on the post or DM @alliehigdem.author on Threads.
